title: Wholesome Girlies vs Babymigo: First Pregnancy in Nigeria
description: Wholesome Girlies and Babymigo compared for a first pregnancy in Nigeria: price, account, where your dates are kept, and where Babymigo is ahead.
share: Expecting your first baby in Nigeria? This compares Wholesome Girlies and Babymigo on price, privacy and what each one does best.
kicker: Which is better for a first pregnancy in Nigeria?
answer: Use Babymigo to find a hospital or a lactation consultant near you, ask other women and doctors a question, or join a live online class. Use Wholesome Girlies for a week by week plan for a first pregnancy, tools that need no account and keep your dates only on your phone, and questions to print for your antenatal visit. PreggClass is a class and The First Pregnancy Plan is a plan, so they are different products, and you can use both. We make no claim of better medical guidance.

image.alt: Illustration of Zainab, pregnant, looking at a week-by-week chart

disclaimer.strong: This page compares a parenting forum and a plan. It cannot tell you what is normal for your pregnancy.
disclaimer.rest: It is educational, not medical advice, and no clinician has reviewed it yet.

doctor: See a doctor or go to hospital if you have bleeding, severe or persistent pain, fever, vomiting so severe you cannot keep fluids down, a bad headache with blurred vision, sudden swelling of the face and hands, or fluid leaking. If you are unsure, call. Nobody minds a call that turns out to be nothing.
legend: A tick marks something we can show in our own code or a cited source. Babymigo facts come from Babymigo's own pages, and its numbers are its own.

rows.label: What it is
rows.wg: Tools, guides and The First Pregnancy Plan, a paced plan for a first pregnancy.
rows.other: A Nigerian parenting forum on the web, with expert questions and answers, articles, tools, a directory of local providers and PreggClass, an online antenatal class.

rows.label: A paced plan
rows.wg: The First Pregnancy Plan has five parts: Know What's Happening (Week by Week), Is This Normal?, What Can I Eat, Understand Your Scans and Tests, and Get Ready for Birth.
rows.other: Articles, forum threads and classes, plus a pregnancy week by week page.

rows.label: Price
rows.wg: The tools need no card. The First Pregnancy Plan is ₦5,700 early-bird (₦13,700 standard), paid once. Buyers abroad pay $12 early-bird ($27 standard).
rows.other: The forum, articles, tools and directory show no price. PreggClass, for individuals, partners or couples, is ₦10,000 (about $7.50) a class, shown beside ₦20,500 (about $15) struck through. A class and a plan are different products.

rows.label: Account to use the tools
rows.wg: None. The due date calculator, week by week tracker, antenatal appointment questions and safe foods checklist open with no sign-in.
rows.other: Forum threads, articles and the directory open without signing in. Posting needs a login with Gmail, Facebook or email. Its home page says you can ask questions anonymously.

rows.label: Where your dates are kept
rows.wg: Only on your phone. The due date calculator and week by week tracker say: Saved only on this phone. Nothing is sent to us.
rows.other: Its privacy policy says it may ask for your expected delivery date, location, mobile number and email address. The relevant lines are quoted below.

rows.label: Questions for your doctor
rows.wg: Antenatal Appointment Questions lets you tick what you want to ask, add your own, print it and take it along.
rows.other: You ask on its forum and read replies from other women and doctors.

rows.label: Nigerian context
rows.wg: It is written for Nigerian and diaspora women and shows prices in naira and dollars.
rows.other: Lists providers in Lagos, Abuja, Ibadan, Port Harcourt, Kano, Calabar and Kaduna, with Ghana and Kenya in its header.

rows.label: Finding a provider
rows.other: Its pages say it lists 50+ breastfeeding consultants, 1000+ maternity hospitals and 5000+ creches and day care centres across Nigerian states.

rows.label: Asking other women and doctors
rows.wg: Our community is open only to program buyers.
rows.other: Its home page says "Join 250,000+ members", and that count is Babymigo's own. It says answers come from experienced mothers and doctors. Its rules page says: "Babymigo cannot guarantee the correctness of the answers or comments posted by users."

rows.label: A live class
rows.wg: The Plan has no live class.
rows.other: PreggClass is an online antenatal class led by a trained and board certified gynaecologist, paediatrician or midwife, by its own page.

wins.b: The First Pregnancy Plan takes you from your first week to getting ready for birth in five parts, with the community and the Girlies app. You keep all of it.
The Plan is ₦5,700 early-bird (₦13,700 standard), paid once, or $12 early-bird ($27 standard) for buyers abroad. Nothing recurs.

wins.h: The tools need no account and no card
wins.b: The due date calculator, week by week tracker, antenatal appointment questions, safe foods checklist, birth plan builder, hospital bag checklist and newborn essentials checklist open with no sign-in and have no payment step. The Plan opens with the email you paid with.

wins.h: Your dates stay on your phone
wins.b: The due date calculator and the week by week tracker keep your date in storage on your phone. The pages say: Saved only on this phone. Nothing is sent to us.

wins.h: Questions to print for the clinic
wins.b: Antenatal Appointment Questions lets you tick, add your own and print.

wins.h: A new phone, and no data needed
wins.b: The Girlies app has Save a backup and Restore a backup, so your saved entries move to a new phone in one file. Once the app is installed, the tools work even when you have no data.

other_ahead.b: Babymigo has a directory with 50+ breastfeeding consultants, 1000+ maternity hospitals and 5000+ creches and day care centres, by its own pages. We have no directory.
Its forum has more than 250,000 members, by Babymigo's own count, and questions get answers from other mothers and doctors. Our community is open only to program buyers.
PreggClass is an online antenatal class at ₦10,000 (about $7.50) a class. The First Pregnancy Plan has no live class.

faq.q: Does the Wholesome Girlies Plan need an account?
faq.a: The tools need no account and no card. The Plan opens with the email you paid with, and you enter a code we send to it.
Yes. Use Babymigo's directory and forum, and use the Wholesome Girlies tools and The First Pregnancy Plan for the week by week plan and the questions for your visit.
